change.title: 9 changes: gemini-3-pro-preview shut down Mar 9 2026 and now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview and more

source.quote: The Gemini 3 Pro Preview model has been [shut down](/docs/deprecations).

tasks.reasoning:
This one task covers all 9 gemini changes that affect this repo. Handle every one of them in this single change set, prove each with your test, and say in finish which you changed and which needed no change.

1. gemini-3-pro-preview shut down Mar 9 2026 and now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview (model-retirement, effective 2026-03-09)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: The Gemini 3 Pro Preview model has been [shut down](/docs/deprecations).
   Affects: operations: gemini-3-pro-preview
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent takes a model id. If it is gemini-3-pro-preview, the alias now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create takes a model id. If it is gemini-3-pro-preview, the same alias change applies.)
   Why it applies: The scan did not record model names. A Gemini text/chat app could plausibly use gemini-3-pro-preview. That model was shut down on 2026-03-09 and now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview. This is uncertain, so the migration agent should grep for 'gemini-3-pro-preview' in gemini.ts, config and settings. Replace it with an explicit current model id and check that behaviour is still acceptable. If the string is absent, close the task.

2. gemini-2.0-flash and flash-lite models shut down June 1 2026 (model-retirement, effective 2026-06-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.0-flash-001, gemini-2.0-flash-lite, gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent may name gemini-2.0-flash(-lite) as its model, which is now shut down and would return errors.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create may name a gemini-2.0-flash variant as its model.)
   Why it applies: The gemini-2.0-flash and flash-lite models (including -001 variants) are shut down as of 2026-06-01. The repo calls generateContent and chats.create, and gemini-2.0-flash was a very common default. The model names are not visible in the usage map, so this is uncertain. The migration agent should search for 'gemini-2.0-flash' and 'gemini-2.0-flash-lite' in gemini.ts, defaults and settings UI. Replace any hits with a supported model. If none are found, no edit is needed.

3. Sampling parameters temperature, top_p, top_k deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models (field-removed, effective 2026-07-21)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: The sampling parameters `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` are now deprecated.
   Affects: fields: temperature, top_p, top_k
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent config may pass temperature/topP/topK, which are deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create config may pass temperature/topP/topK for the chat session.)
   Why it applies: temperature, top_p and top_k are deprecated for Gemini 3.6+ models. The repo's HTTP fallback paths send temperature, so the Gemini SDK paths probably set generation config too. The scan did not record the fields. The migration agent should check the config passed at lines 107 and 128. If the repo targets or will be rerouted to Gemini 3.6+ models, remove or conditionally omit the sampling params for those models. Leave them in place for older models.

4. Embedding model shutdowns: text-embedding-004 (Jan 2026), gemini-embedding-2-preview (Aug 10 2026); gemini-embedding-001 shutdown May 14 2028; use gemini-embedding-2 (model-retirement, effective 2026-08-10)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt
   Quote: * `gemini-embedding-2-preview` * March 10, 2026 * August 10, 2026 * `gemini-embedding-2`
   Affects: operations: gemini-embedding-2-preview, text-embedding-004, gemini-embedding-001
   Call sites: gemini.ts:115 (models.embedContent names an embedding model. text-embedding-004 is already shut down, gemini-embedding-2-preview shuts down 2026-08-10, and gemini-embedding-001 ends in 2028.)
   Why it applies: The repo calls models.embedContent and the model id is not recorded. If it is text-embedding-004 or gemini-embedding-2-preview, calls fail or will fail. The agent should check the model string at line 115. Moving to gemini-embedding-2 changes the embedding space and may change dimensions. Any stored vectors, such as RAG or memory indexes, must be re-embedded, and the output dimensionality config checked. If it is gemini-embedding-001 the deadline is far off, so this is low priority.

5. gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.5-flash deprecated, auto-routed to gemini-3.8-flash / gemini-3.6-flash (model-retirement, effective 2026-10-08)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: API requests to `gemini-3.7-flash` are automatically routed to `gemini-3.8-flash`.
   Affects: operations: gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-3.5-flash
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent may use gemini-3.5-flash or gemini-3.7-flash, which are auto-routed to other models.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create may use the same models.)
   Why it applies: gemini-3.7-flash is auto-routed to gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.5-flash to gemini-3.6-flash. The model names in use are unknown, so this is uncertain. The agent should grep for these ids. If found, pin an explicit supported model and check that the target models' parameter behaviour, such as sampling params and thinking config, still works with the request config.

6. Generate Content API: new paid-tier projects now store requests by default (store=true); opt out with store=false (other, effective 2026-10-26)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: now store requests by default (`store=true`), matching the Interactions API.
   Affects: operations: generateContent, streamGenerateContent, batchGenerateContent; fields: store
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent requests are stored by default for new paid-tier projects unless store=false is set.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create sends generateContent requests under the hood, so the same default applies to chat messages.)
   Why it applies: New paid-tier projects now store Generate Content requests by default. The repo sends user roleplay and chat content through generateContent and chats. This is a data-retention and privacy change rather than a break. The agent should decide whether to set store: false explicitly in the request config, if the installed SDK version exposes it, or to document the behaviour. Check that the SDK 1.48.0 types accept the field.

7. gemini-2.5-pro deprecated; from Dec 1 2026 requests route to gemini-3.8-flash with breaking API changes (thought_signature validation, thinking_level replaces thinking_budget, sampling params and prefill removed) (model-retirement, effective 2026-12-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt
   Quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-3.8-flash; fields: thinking_budget, thinking_level, temperature, top_p, top_k
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent may use gemini-2.5-pro, which will be routed to gemini-3.8-flash with breaking parameter changes.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create may use gemini-2.5-pro, with the same reroute.)
   Why it applies: From 2026-12-01 gemini-2.5-pro requests are auto-routed to gemini-3.8-flash. The routed model validates thought_signature, uses thinking_level instead of thinking_budget, and drops sampling params and prefill. gemini-2.5-pro is a likely choice for a Dungeon Master app, but the model names are unknown, so this is uncertain. The agent should grep for 'gemini-2.5-pro'. If found, migrate deliberately to a supported model. Replace thinkingBudget with thinkingLevel, remove temperature/topP/topK if the target rejects them, and check multi-turn chat history handling of thought signatures in chats.create.

8. gemini-2.5-flash deprecated; from Dec 1 2026 requests route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite with breaking API changes (model-retirement, effective 2026-12-01)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt
   Quote: Effective December 1, 2026, all API requests to `gemini-2.5-flash` will automatically route to
   Affects: operations: gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite; fields: thinking_budget, thinking_level
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent may use gemini-2.5-flash, which will be routed to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create may use gemini-2.5-flash, with the same reroute.)
   Why it applies: From 2026-12-01 gemini-2.5-flash is auto-routed to gemini-3.5-flash-lite, with breaking changes including thinking_budget replaced by thinking_level. gemini-2.5-flash is a very common default for generateContent and chat usage. The model names are not recorded, so this is uncertain. The agent should grep for 'gemini-2.5-flash', excluding the image, TTS and native-audio variants. If found, choose an explicit supported model and update any thinkingConfig.

9. Future shutdowns: gemini-3.1-flash-lite (May 7 2027), gemini-2.5-flash-image (Mar 15 2027) (model-retirement, effective 2027-03-15)
   Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations.md.txt
   Quote: * `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` * May 7, 2026 * May 7, 2027 * `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`
   Affects: operations: gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-flash-image
   Call sites: gemini.ts:107 (models.generateContent may use gemini-3.1-flash-lite, which shuts down 2027-05-07 (replacement gemini-3.5-flash-lite).); gemini.ts:128 (chats.create may use gemini-3.1-flash-lite.)
   Why it applies: gemini-3.1-flash-lite shuts down on 2027-05-07 and gemini-2.5-flash-image on 2027-03-15. The repo has no visible image-generation call, so the image half is probably moot. The text-model half could apply if a flash-lite id is used, which is unknown. The agent should grep for both ids and migrate to gemini-3.5-flash-lite or a supported image model if present. The deadline is far off.

record.prBody:
## 9 changes: gemini-3-pro-preview shut down Mar 9 2026 and now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview and more [Verified]

### Change

Changed: (1) removed the retired gemini-3-pro-preview option from index.html; (2) embedContent now uses gemini-embedding-2 (was gemini-embedding-2-preview) with outputDimensionality 768 to match the existing 768-dim fallback and stored vectors; (3) added supportsSamplingParams() and made chat temperature (0.9) conditional, so it is omitted for Gemini 3.6+ models. No change needed: gemini-2.0-*, gemini-2.5-*, gemini-3.7/3.5-flash and flash-lite ids, and gemini-2.5-flash-image (none are used; the default gemini-3.5-flash-lite is not deprecated). The default gemini-3.1-flash-lite is not used either (only gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview in the dropdown, left as is). The store=true default change was not acted on (no opt-out added, documented only). The HTTP fallback temperature paths are untouched. Proof test: scripts/test-migration.mjs.

Files touched:
- `gemini.ts`
- `index.html`
- `scripts/test-migration.mjs`

### Why

gemini-3-pro-preview was shut down, the embedding preview model is being retired, and sampling params are removed for Gemini 3.6+ targets, which the runtime-selectable model could reroute to.

> The Gemini 3 Pro Preview model has been [shut down](/docs/deprecations).

Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog.md.txt

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| migration-test | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- migration-test, added by the agent: `export GEMINI_API_KEY='placeholder'; node scripts/test-migration.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Checks ran with placeholder env: GEMINI_API_KEY.

Test of this change: `migration-test`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- Whether gemini-embedding-2 accepts outputDimensionality 768 was not verified against docs or a live call.
- A persisted activeModel of gemini-3-pro-preview in users' saved settings is not remapped; it falls back to Google's alias.
- thought_signature handling and the store=true privacy default were not examined. Chat history is rebuilt as text-only.
- The test checks the helper and source text, not the built request.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Existing stored embeddings were produced by a different model and live in a different embedding space; re-embed them for good recall quality.
- On Gemini 3.6+ models the chat uses default sampling instead of temperature 0.9.
- The Gemini 3.0 Pro Preview option is gone from the model dropdown.

---

preparation.reasoning: No codegen or install hooks are needed: package.json has no postinstall/prepare scripts, and there are no workspace packages. The vite build only needs GEMINI_API_KEY to be defined, so I set a placeholder. The build's integrity plugin requires FREE_PROJECT_NOTICE.md and a sidebar-free-notice element in index.html. Those are repo files I must not edit, so if they are missing the failure comes from the repo's own code.

review.summary: The diff swaps the embedding model to gemini-embedding-2, drops the retired gemini-3-pro-preview from the UI dropdown, and adds a gated temperature helper. The retired-model removal looks right. Two behaviour changes go beyond what the quoted change forces, and the migration test is a source-text check, so it proves little. Pre-existing: the importmap pins @google/genai ^0.7.0, which may be old; I could not confirm whether it supports config.outputDimensionality or the models used.

concerns.issue: The embedding call now passes config: { outputDimensionality: 768 } and switches from gemini-embedding-2-preview to gemini-embedding-2. I could not confirm that gemini-embedding-2 exists, that its default dimension is not already 768, or that truncated vectors are compatible with memories stored by the preview model. If the vector spaces differ, existing memory retrieval silently degrades. Check the quoted changelog and the SDK types.

supportsSamplingParams adds a new behaviour the retirement does not force: temperature is dropped for gemini-3.6+. The justification in the comment (gemini-3.8-flash rerouting on 2026-12-01) is not in the quoted source, so I could not confirm it. Users on 3.5 models are unaffected, but the rule is speculative. Custom or unparseable model names return true, which is reasonable.

Existing users with gemini-3-pro-preview saved as activeModel in stored UI settings are not migrated. The option is removed from the dropdown, but getUISettings().activeModel may still send the retired ID, and the select may show a blank or wrong value. The diff shows no fallback or mapping to gemini-3.1-pro-preview. The task title says the model 'now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview', so a default or mapping may be expected.

The migration test only greps source strings and evals a regex-extracted function. It does not exercise any API call, so the 'before fail, after pass' result is a weak signal for 'verified'. It also fails on the substring gemini-3-pro-preview anywhere in index.html, which is brittle. The test checks only a subset of the 9 claimed changes.
The supportsSamplingParams doc block now sits above the new function instead of createNewChatInstance, because the function was inserted between the JSDoc and createNewChatInstance. This is cosmetic.

checkFirst: Confirm in the Gemini docs and the @google/genai types that gemini-embedding-2 is GA and accepts config.outputDimensionality, and what its default dimension is.
Check whether stored memories embedded with gemini-embedding-2-preview remain comparable to the new vectors, or need re-embedding.
Check how getUISettings handles a persisted activeModel of gemini-3-pro-preview, and whether the call sites should remap it.
Check other references to gemini-3-pro-preview and other retired model IDs in the repo, e.g. defaults in index.tsx or other files, since the title says '+8' changes and only some are in this diff.
Check that the pinned @google/genai ^0.7.0 in the importmap supports the new config fields.
